title: The board's delivery records under ballot version 5: the rolling posting call with its supplied root, and the version-2 receipts, complaints, batches and roots of a rolling poll
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/delivery-v5-vectors.py, an implementation of contracts.md's Board, Delivery records (ballot version 5) in Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or any @noble library. It reuses ballot-v5-records-vectors.py's rolling elections, step trees, record encoder, hashes and witnesses, share-encryption-v4-vectors.py's version-4 encryption (over its self-checked ML-KEM-768, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and ristretto255), delivery-v2-vectors.py's and delivery-batch-v2-vectors.py's version-2 records, RFC 6979 P-256 ECDSA and relay-vectors.py's Keccak-256; membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5, and every pairing verdict snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record, the definition and the supplied root. The fixed poll's ballot and ciphertext are intake-v4.json's. Secrets are SHA-256 of fixed labels: test data only
